subject: Rewrite XXH3_update

units.name: Rewrite XXH3_update
units.evidence: Three fixed streaming targets prove bidirectionally; short-update and 128-bit paths time out, while longer variants lack a return in the checker IR.

units.name: Three fixed-length public XXH3 64-bit streaming calls with 136-byte secret
units.precondition: Clang 20 x86-64-v3; valid buffers; totalLen/extSecret pin assumptions in shared wrapper
units.evidence: Six source-locked bidirectional Alive2 checks for 700, 300+400, and 1100 bytes all prove.

notes: Three fixed-length public streaming paths prove bidirectionally with source-locked IR; boundary and 128-bit paths remain unresolved.
